name: Forum Membership
description: A dated seat on a forum. Standalone, not a child table, by structural decision : membership history survives independently, so the composition of a forum at any past date is a date-range filter rather than a replay of version diffs. Closed by setting an end date, never by deleting the row.

fields.label: Seat Type
fields.description: A Position seat survives the person leaving; it may stand vacant.

fields.label: Member
fields.description: Empty only where the seat is by position and currently vacant.

fields.label: Position Title
fields.description: Required when the seat is by position. The seat's identity, independent of its occupant.

fields.label: Seat Role
fields.description: Brings counts_toward_quorum, votes_by_default and can_attest as defaults.

fields.label: Votes
fields.description: Defaults from the role, overridable per seat. This is the field voting entitlement reads.

fields.label: Counts Toward Quorum
fields.description: Defaults from the role, overridable per seat.

fields.label: Is Voting Chair
fields.description: Whether the chair holds a casting vote.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: Empty means current. Closing a seat sets this; it never deletes the row.

fields.label: End Reason
fields.options:
Term Ended
Left Organisation
Role Change
Forum Disbanded
Removed

fields.label: Delegate
fields.description: The standing delegate for this seat.

fields.label: Delegate Votes
fields.description: Whether the delegate may vote or only attend. A delegate never inherits a vote the seat does not hold.

fields.label: Authority Delegation
fields.description: Where the delegation is formal and wider than this seat.
